creator: nate.b.jones
title: Review of Instinct, an invite-only proactive iMessage agent that checked the creator into a flight and added the boarding pass to Apple Wallet unprompted

tools.name: Instinct
tools.detail: Invite-only proactive agent, entirely over iMessage; no URL shown

tools.name: Apple Wallet
tools.detail: Agent sent a link that added the boarding pass to Wallet

claims: Instinct is 'the buzziest AI agent in the valley right now'
It proactively texted the creator before a flight offering to check him in
Five minutes later it returned a Wallet link; one click added a legitimate boarding pass, with zero navigating of airline sites or apps
Creator does not think the single use case justifies an agent, but sees it as a sign of proactive agents to come
on_screen_only: Title card: 'AI Review: I Tried Instinct And My Jaw Hit The Floor'
Talking-head only; no product UI shown
cta: Comment what surprised you if you use Instinct, or what would surprise you if you do not

relevance.why: Consumer-life agent, invite-only, not a building tool; mildly relevant as a signal that proactive, trigger-based agents are the next product pattern.

implement_score.why: Nothing to adopt; at most a product-design note that proactive triggers (calendar/email events) beat chat prompts for user delight.
